TextBlock.Text: THEATRE The southern route
DATE 12 December 2028 · 0915 local
SIDE Royal Australian Navy
WINDOW 70 min, closes at 105
MH-60R Seahawk. Photo: U.S. Navy/Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Andrew Langholf · Public domain · cropped
"Simply stated, strategic deterrence is about communicating capability and intent."
- Adm. Cecil D. Haney, Commander, US Strategic Command

THE SOUTHERN ROUTE, mid-morning. WILKINS 03, the A319 airlink to Wilkins Aerodrome, lost contact on the Hobart-Casey track at 0352 and put down on the water eighteen minutes later. Her distress beacon transmitted for forty minutes and then stopped. Failure, damage or deliberate interference are all possible; the cessation alone does not establish what happened.

A longliner heard it and reported it. A factory trawler from the fleet that shadowed the Storm Bay convoy was closer, and the trawler is now holding position sixty miles west of the datum, answering nobody, with the research trawler NAN HAI 27 steaming to meet her.

You have your escort group with the Seahawk and the Poseidon you brought, and SENTRY 21 high to the south. Six contacts are in the search box: longliners, a factory trawler that is only fishing, the expedition cruise ship POLAR HORIZON southbound, a whale, and the one that matters. Classify her and put your flagship within three miles of her. Your weapons are tight, and a shot at the wrong hull is a shot at the crew.

SEARCH UPDATE: Satellite detections and the last AIS reports narrow the surface search. They do not identify who recovered the survivors. Correlate the longliner's witness report with local sensor contacts before approaching the suspected trawler.
Commodore Alex Mercer; Wing Commander Daniel Ward for the search plan
COMMANDER'S INTENT

WILKINS 03 put down on the water at 0410 and the longliner reports survivors. The distress beacon provided a datum; it could not confirm their condition. Something recovered them before we could, and it is not steaming for Hobart. Find it among the traffic, classify it, and put a ship alongside. Do not fire at anything on the water today - the people we want are on one of those decks.
• Classify the trawler holding the crew, then put your flagship within three miles of her
• Harm no fishing boat, cruise ship or whale
• Bring your flagship out intact
• Classify Nan Hai 27 as well

Your escort group with one MH-60R and one P-8A if assigned, one MQ-4C Triton overhead. Neutral: two longliners, a factory trawler, an expedition cruise ship, a whale. Opposing: the trawler holding the crew, unarmed; the research trawler Nan Hai 27 closing to meet her.

The planned window is 70 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 35 minutes more; the operation is closed at 105 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
